resources.string: Type the code your watch shows. It signs in to your account and then syncs on its own.
Wrong or expired code. Get a new one on the watch.
Too many wrong codes. Wait a few minutes and try again.
Connect an account first: your data is only on this device.
Couldn\'t connect the watch. Try again.
Connecting the watch needs the internet.
Type only a code shown on your own watch: whoever has that watch gets into your account.
The code is valid for 5 minutes, once.
It sees your groups and syncs on its own. To disconnect it, sign out on the watch.
